public_rationale: Independent research documents the difficulty at both endpoints. Haley and Soloway reported extrapolation limitations in 1992. GSM-Plus documented robustness failures across contemporary language models before August 2024. Those findings support persistence of a problem. They do not imply that all systems fail, that no progress occurred, or that the mechanisms and severity were unchanged.
limitations: The historical evidence is the paper's abstract in NASA's repository; the record provides no full-paper download.
The historical availability date follows NASA's publication metadata, which gives January 1, 1992.
The contemporary study does not expose proprietary training sets.
